text_block_list.text:
After the race, Symboli Kris S declares 
that her next race won't be the Kikuka 
Sho, but the mixed Senior-class Tenno Sho 
(Autumn).

Because of this, the Kikuka Sho was left 
without its top two contenders. It was a 
golden opportunity, yet Hishi Miracle 
remained reluctant to run.

The Trainer felt it was better to have her 
race even if forced, and pushed through 
the decision to enter the Kikuka Sho.
